info.title: Inkay Updater
info.author: KaisenKai
info.description: Tool for updating Pretendo and Protarium
info.details:
A Wii U app that keeps Inkay up to date for Pretendo Network and Protarium Network, built for Aroma.

See every Aroma environment on your SD card in one list, with its network, installed Inkay version and whether an update is available. Pick Pretendo or Protarium per environment and install with one press of A.

Inkay is downloaded straight from the official Pretendo and Protarium GitHub releases. The download is checked first, and your old Inkay is put back if anything goes wrong.

Restart your Wii U after updating so the new Inkay loads. You still need a Pretendo or Protarium account to go online.

Comes with original background music, which you can turn off with Y.

AI use: AI-assisted. AI also used for: icon/banner art.
